title: Sharp Monotonicity Boundaries, Monotone-Forbidden Spurious Quantum Mpemba Effects, Analytic Ordered-SWAP Phase Transitions, and Mixed-State Duality Laws for Rényi Entanglement Asymmetry
abstract: Travaglino, Mazzoni, and Calabrese (2026, arXiv:2611.34853v1) introduced sandwiched Rényi divergence probes S^(alpha)(rho || rho_Q) of U(1) entanglement asymmetry, establishing a two-parameter replica framework, an asymptotic index-inversion correspondence S^(alpha) ~ Delta S^(1/alpha) for homogeneous quenches and Haar-random states, and numerical evidence for an alpha_c = 1/2 Mpemba transition in an ordered-SWAP toy model. We resolve the four central resource-theoretic, dynamical, and mixed-state structural questions left open by arXiv:2611.34853v1 via four exact, machine-checked theorems backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (zero external imports, zero sorry, zero Classical.choice, zero warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float exact-rational SHA-256 certificates (MANIFEST SHA-256: 57f6d9f453cce79895bff08ac9f71c170f04dba3c41e6f4302555026ffb2a622), and 60 adversarial tests: (1) Exact Sharp U(1)-Monotonicity Phase Diagram & Low-Dimensional Counterexamples: we prove the exact U(1)-covariant monotonicity domains are {1} for Delta S^(alpha), [0, 2] for Petz D_alpha, and [1/2, infty] for sandwiched S^(alpha), via a two-qubit classical-flag escort-weight obstruction under Tr_B defeating Delta S^(alpha) for every alpha != 1 (exact rational witnesses 445 > 424 at alpha = 2, 973 > 820 at alpha = 3, and (1/5, 120/169, 24/25) at alpha = 1/2), single-qubit (d = 2) U(1)-covariant amplitude damping defeating Delta S^(alpha) for all alpha >= 2 (463/373 > 50/41) and Petz D_alpha for all alpha > 2 (exact limit ((alpha-2)/(alpha-1)) log(1/(1-eta)) > 0 and Cayley-Hamilton witness 7219/361 > 100/9 at alpha = 3), and a rank-2 qutrit (d = 3) family under strongly U(1)-symmetric pinching defeating S^(alpha) for every alpha in (0, 1/2) via strict convexity of g(p) = <u|B_0^(-p)|u>/4^p - 1/2 with exact zeros g(1) = g(2) = 0 plus a pure five-integer-inequality certificate at alpha = 1/4 (T = 815/6561, P = 1825/3^14); (2) Monotone-Forbidden Spurious Quantum Mpemba Effects: on two qubits under the U(1)-covariant Markov semigroup Lambda_t = E_{kappa t}^(A) x D_{gamma t}^(B), we exhibit an exact time-independent CPTP intertwining sigma_AB(t) = Phi_kill(rho_AB(t)) for all t >= 0 forbidding any QME crossing in every U(1)-asymmetry monotone, while Delta S^(2) displays a permanent spurious QME at the exact kappa-independent crossing time t_*(2) = (1/gamma) log((1-w)/q_*) (witness (3/4, 1/2, 1, 3/5) yielding 2048 q^2 - 848 q + 49 = 0), extending to every alpha in (0, 1) U (1, infty); (3) Analytic Resolution of the Ordered-SWAP Mpemba Phase Transition at alpha_c = 1/2: we prove all-k collision-entropy degeneracy at alpha = 1/2 via Parseval's identity and resolve the N_S = 2 phase transition analytically for every p in (0, 1/2) and every alpha > 0 using Laguerre-Descartes' Rule of Signs on a 5-term Dirichlet polynomial with 3 exact zeros {0, 1, 2} and at most 3 sign changes across all three base-ordering regimes, complemented by an exact rational reversal witness for homogeneous Bin(2, p) at beta = 5 (alpha = 1/5) on (p_1, p_2) = (2/5, 9/20); and (4) Mixed-State Duality Dichotomy, Universal Single-Qubit Deficits, d = 3 Breakdown, & Pinching/Replica Laws: resolving Open Question 1 of arXiv:2611.34853v1, we separate the pure-factorized index-inverted regime (S^(alpha) = Delta S^(1/alpha)) from the flat-twirl commuting index-preserving regime (S^(alpha) = D_alpha = Delta S^(alpha)), establish universal single-qubit (d = 2) ordering S^(1/2) <= min(Delta S^(1/2), Delta S^(2)) and S^(2) >= max(Delta S^(1/2), Delta S^(2)) via four exact polynomial deficit factorizations, prove simultaneous d = 3 breakdown of all four inequalities on rho_w = w|+_{02}><+_{02}| + (1-w)|1><1| at w = 1/5 (578 < 1089, 36 < 50) and w = 4/5 (162 < 196, 81 < 85), derive universal K-sector pinching ceilings (0 <= S^(alpha), Delta S^(2) <= log K), and prove an exact finite-group Z_K two-parameter replica charged-moment identity.
